title: CIA-UAP-003, The Central Intelligence Agency and Overhead Reconnaissance; The U-2 and OXCART Programs, 1954-1974
doc_notes: This document is a declassified history of the CIA's U-2 and OXCART overhead reconnaissance programs, which contains references to historical overflight incidents involving foreign aircraft. / This document is a historical account of the CIA's U-2 overhead reconnaissance program from 1954 to 1974 and contains no reports of UAP or alien encounters. / This document is a declassified CIA history of the U-2 and OXCART reconnaissance programs from 1954-1974 and contains no reports of UAP or extraterrestrial encounters. / This document is a historical account of the CIA's overhead reconnaissance programs (U-2 and OXCART) and contains no reports of UAP or alien encounters.

encounters.summary: A British Canberra aircraft conducted an overflight of the Soviet missile test range at Kapustin Yar in 1953 and was nearly shot down by Soviet fighters.
encounters.quote: Soviet fighters damaged and nearly shot down the Canberra.
